title: 第15章 青霄蕴灵诀第16章 宗主师兄这招实在是高
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
大殿光影晃动，一道身影步入殿内，正是林清瑶。
她出现的瞬间，殿内所有峰主齐刷刷的向她看去。
同时，几道神念也悄然向她而去，探查起了她的修为境界。
林清瑶来到大殿中央，对着上首的玄辉真人及两侧的峰主们屈身行礼：
“弟子烟霞峰林清瑶，拜见宗主，拜见诸位峰主。”
短暂的寂静。
几位峰主相互交换了一个眼神，脸上皆露出了确认后的喜色！
筑基六重！
货真价实！
根基虽略显虚浮，显然是刚刚才到达筑基六重。
但境界稳固，做不得假！
玄辉真人眼中精光一闪，心中大喜。
真的是筑基六重，好好好。
如此天骄不多见啊！
他看着林清瑶那屈身的样子，开口道：“直起身来吧。”
“是宗主。”
林清瑶依言起身，垂首恭立。
玄辉真人凝视着她，缓缓问道：“本座与诸位峰主召你前来，是有一事询问。”
“你入内门不过数日，修为却从炼气十重一路攀升至筑基六重，你是如何做到的？”
此言一出，所有峰主的目光再次聚焦她身上，等待着她的答案。

林清瑶心中早有准备，毕竟今日陆鸣叮嘱过她。
她抬起头，语气没有丝毫犹豫，朗声回答道：
“回禀宗主，弟子愚钝，只是于修行一道偶有所悟，加之日夜勤修不停，未曾想进境快了些许，实属侥幸。”
“偶有所悟？勤修不停？”
此话一出一位峰主，忍不住出声：“何等悟性，能让你数日连破数境？！”
林清瑶神色不变，依旧平静地回答：
“弟子也不知道，只是修炼之时，每每感觉如有神助，诸多关隘水到渠成，并未感到太多阻碍。”
她这话半真半假，修炼时确实如有神助，只不过这个“神”
指的是陆鸣就是了。
“嘶~”
闻言，大殿内响起几声细微的吸气声。
诸位峰主面面相觑，眼中震惊更甚。
此等天资……此等悟性……
这已非天才，简直是妖孽！
content_en:
The light and shadow in the main hall shook, and a figure walked into the hall, it was Lin Qingyao.
The moment she appeared, all the peak masters in the palace looked at her.
At the same time, several spiritual thoughts also quietly went to her, exploring her cultivation realm.
Lin Qingyao came to the center of the hall and bowed to the master Xuanhui at the head and the peak masters on both sides:
"Disciple Yanxia Peak Lin Qingyao, pay homage to the sect master, and pay homage to all the peak masters."
A brief moment of silence.
Several peak leaders exchanged glances with each other, and their faces showed joy after confirmation!
Sixth level of foundation building!
The real deal!
Although the foundation is a bit flimsy, it is obvious that it has just reached the sixth level of foundation building.
But the realm is stable and cannot be faked!
Master Xuanhui's eyes flashed, and he was overjoyed.
It’s really the sixth level of foundation building, good, good, good.
It’s rare to see such a talented person!
He looked at Lin Qingyao's hunched over state and said, "Straighten up."
"It's the sect leader."
Lin Qingyao stood up as instructed and stood respectfully with her head bowed.
Master Xuanhui stared at her and asked slowly: "I and the other peak masters have called you here to inquire about something."
"You have only been in the Inner Sect for a few days, but your cultivation level has climbed from the tenth level of Qi Refining to the sixth level of Foundation Establishment. How did you do it?"
As soon as she said this, all the peak masters' eyes focused on her again, waiting for her answer.
Lin Qingyao was already prepared. After all, Lu Ming had warned her today.
She raised her head and answered loudly without any hesitation:
"Reporting to the sect master, this disciple is stupid. He only had some enlightenment by chance while practicing. In addition, he practiced diligently day and night. He didn't expect that he entered the realm a little faster. It's really a fluke."
"Sometimes you have enlightenment? Do you practice diligently?"
As soon as these words came out, a peak master couldn't help but say: "What kind of understanding can allow you to break through several realms for several days?!"
Lin Qingyao's expression remained unchanged and she still answered calmly:
"The disciples don't know either. It's just that when I practice, I always feel like I have divine help. Many obstacles are easily solved and I don't feel too many obstacles."
What she said is half true and half false. It is indeed like having divine help during cultivation, but this "god"
It just refers to Lu Ming.
"Hiss~"
Hearing this, several subtle inhalations sounded in the hall.
The peak masters looked at each other with shock in their eyes.
Such talent...such understanding...
This is no longer a genius, this is simply a monster!
